acceptanceCriteria: A retained regression covers a read-only stage that edits the candidate.
The refusal is typed and non-retryable and the attempt reaches a blocked or recoverable state.
body: Observed on branch claude/v1-0475-multi-repo (head e62e5bdb, base origin/main d524530f), Corvint 1.0.0-rc.1 build 163, Go 1.27.1, darwin/arm64, by the issue 354 lane. Reproduced with a scratch probe that was not retained; structure predates the branch (d524530f). Steps: implement to BUILT, then a review stage that exits cleanly after editing the candidate worktree. Actual: read-only stage changed candidate as a retryable MALFORMED, the attempt left STOPPING with worker=true, and a rerun of run --role reviewer refuses RESOURCE_COLLISION. Expected: a non-retryable typed refusal and a blocked or recoverable attempt. No test covers this path.

completion.reason: Delivered on main ae3b418152fe4c42f52ac7cfdc16ecc12159607e via batch beamfall/corvint#1411 (lane #1407); CI green on that commit (runs 39621556421,39618615648). Owner 2026-10-21: CI-checked work needs no local full-gate. Evidence file sha256 249402d493aa46662b8862e1dc4da6d813e136c9457a50dd4892987c992764ab.

title: A read-only stage that edits the candidate leaves the attempt STOPPING and a rerun refuses RESOURCE_COLLISION
